Facility Inventory & Condition Assessmen.justification: Comprehensive district-wide inventory including building age, size, classrooms, portables, and specialized spaces; detailed condition assessments of major systems (HVAC, roofing, plumbing, electrical, lighting, technology, accessibility) with cost estimates and prioritization; connects condition data to student outcomes and long-term capital planning (Sections 5, Needs Assessment, pages 33-80).

Enrollment & Capacity Planning.justification: Provides detailed enrollment projections over 10+ years with methodology; includes capacity utilization data by site and classroom; links capacity analysis to specific facility actions including new construction and portable replacement; discusses adaptive uses and long-term planning (District Statistics, pages 11-13).

Educational Alignment.justification: Plan references educational mission and goals and connects facility projects to educational programs such as TK, special education, and technology upgrades; includes modernization of classrooms and specialized spaces but coverage of programmatic shifts and detailed educational specifications is partial (Executive Summary, Needs Assessment, Stakeholder Engagement).

Outdoor Spaces & Greening.justification: Includes data and analysis of outdoor spaces such as playgrounds, athletic fields, and parking; identifies strategies for improvement including playground equipment replacement, new turf fields, and stormwater management; mentions outdoor learning and health benefits at some sites but not districtwide (Needs Assessment, pages 33-80).

Climate Risk & Mitigation.justification: Acknowledges climate-related issues indirectly through deferred maintenance and infrastructure upgrades but lacks detailed climate risk assessment or comprehensive climate resilience strategies; no central theme of climate readiness in the plan (no explicit sections on climate risk).

Energy Efficiency & Resilience.justification: Mentions ongoing HVAC improvements and solar installation project underway; references technology upgrades and some energy-related infrastructure but lacks comprehensive energy use data, resilience strategies, or explicit reference to state requirements like Title 24 or Zero Net Energy goals (Executive Summary, Funding Future Projects).

Financial Plan & Capital Strategy.justification: Presents detailed cost estimates with escalation assumptions; includes prioritization of projects by category and site; outlines multiple funding sources including state modernization eligibility, local bonds, deferred maintenance, and alternative financing; discusses long-term financial sustainability and funding challenges (Funding Future Projects, pages 25-31).
